segments.text: We first tried Inventory management software in 209. At the time, efficiency needs mattered because we needed visibility across branches.
The biggest issue was Power outages. Without steady power in Aba, costs kept rising.
Our sales changed after Inventory management software—we saw Reduced stock-outs within 12 months.
Policy-wise, Data protection shaped our move. We adjusted by Alternative power.
Data helped; even a Excel-based trendline gave us clearer demand patterns during Sallah.
